items.title: Tom Varner interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 13, 2025
items.q: So that was a nice influence on me in that during that time period, now we’re talking late-‘70s perhaps, I wanted to do all of the approaches at once

ctx.x: Did Chick Corea and his electric band or Weather Report have a space in there somewhere?

Yeah I loved that music when I was – and that also kind of turned me on to like wow, I want to do something not necessarily electric like what was that “Return to Forever.” I did go see them twice and that was really amazing in the – again – early, mid-‘70s. And that was also – structurally it wasn’t just boom-boom-solo-solo-over. Chick had much more of a wider compositional outlook one could say. What’s interesting is more recently I’ve been going back and listening to the music from a few years before that,…
Meanwhile to get into the university of your choice did you have the classical horn repertoire under your belt as well?
